BLUEPRINT:1,10,1101,0,0,0,0,0,639302499987987999,0.10.35.29151,Everything%20Farm%201,,,,This%20is%20the%20base%20level%20without%20holo%20beacons%20and%20nothing%20on%20top%20of%20the%20BAB.%0A%0AThis%20is%20the%20first%20in%20a%20series%20of%207%20%28currently%29%20that%20builds%20out%20at%20the%20tech%20appropriate%20levels.%20This%20BP%20requires%20you%20to%20have%20unlocked%20the%20150%20facilities%20level%20of%20blueprints%20and%20depends%20on%20having%20unlocked%20several%20battle%20techs%20like%20holo%20beacons%2C%20signal%20towers%2C%20BABs%2C%20and%20lasers.%20There%20are%2027%20laser%20turrets%20in%20this%20BP%2C%20which%20is%20intended%20to%20be%20able%20to%20handle%20a%20level%2030%20planetary%20base%20without%20any%20energy%20weapon%20upgrades.%0A%0AIt%20also%20trims%20plasma%20sentries%20and%20only%20allows%203%20of%20the%206%20possible%20raider%20camps%20to%20spawn.%20As%20such%2C%20this%20BP%20only%20allows%20up%20to%20432%20DF%20units%20a%20minute%2C%20verses%20one%20with%20the%20six%20raider%20camps%20which%20allows%20up%20to%20864%20units%20a%20minute.%20This%20BP%20can%20be%20placed%20a%20total%20of%2022%20times%20on%20a%20planet%20for%20a%20total%20of%2044%20dark%20fog%20bases%20on%20a%20single%20planet.%20""27C9CBD623A491C7FF9E382020CD18AA
